# Weekly Scope Gating Skill

## When to use

- At the start of every task, before selecting other skills

## Rule

Only implement what the current week explicitly requires.

## Workflow

1. Read the weekly requirements first.
2. Map each requirement to the minimum skill subset from
   `.github/copilot-instructions.md`.
3. Defer out-of-scope work as roadmap notes only — do not implement it.
4. Typical preflight for API work:
   - feature-branch-workflow
   - tdd-mastery
   - api-route-testing (if routes)
   - security-first (if data exposure)
   - sequel-db-setup (if schema)
